modules for bookings and healthcare, hospitality, automotive, telecoms and internet providers, emergency response, betting, arrears, and much more for debt collection, insurance and Sales; a setup assistant; log streams to your security tools; and more connectors.

Bookings and healthcare module (add-on): appointments for people, rooms and capacity pools, booked, moved and cancelled from the desk or by a customer replying or following a link, with reminders, a no-show sweep, reports, tiles and an alert, and a healthcare starter set. A STOP reply to a reminder withdraws reminder consent.

Hospitality module (add-on): reservations and enquiries with follow-up, a Reservations hub and a Reservations tab on the agent desk. Amounts use your organisation's own currency. It adds a guest profile and guest fields, reports, wallboard tiles and an alert, a Reservations tab in journeys with a starter set, and a guide and Academy course.

Automotive module (add-on): vehicles and their owners, readings, history and service visits, a workshop diary built on Bookings, a vehicle import from a file, a Vehicles tab on the agent desk, workshop reports and a dashboard, and a starter workshop.

Telecoms and ISP module (add-on): network areas and service locations, outages that open one case per area and keep affected customers informed, restore notices, call-spike suggestions and alarms by webhook, the regulator's complaint clock, a Network hub, an outage step in flows, and a Network tab on the desk. Field jobs can be dispatched to the nearest technician, who marks On my way, Arrived and Done on the mobile app, and the customer is told with an arrival time and when the job is done.

Emergency and response module: a Response hub with answer-to-dispatch targets and alerts, reports and a dashboard, a Response tab on the agent desk for emergency lines, caller details that can be verified, and a starter set.

Betting module (add-on, player protection): a Players hub with a player file import, restrictions and permits that block contact in dialling, messaging, calls and imports, a national exclusion register load with approval before bulk ends, player events from your platform by signed webhook and a nightly value feed, and AI agents that see the player's restriction. Limit, cooling-off and self-exclusion requests go to the player system from the wrap-up form; agents get a Player tab on the desk with a live check; and there is a blocked-contacts-by-day report and a Players starter dashboard.

Debt collection module: tracing at the credit bureaus, scheduled skip tracing and payment profiles; legal steps with notices and proof, interest and costs under In Duplum, and attorneys; Creditors, Settlements and Commission tabs, a trust ledger with pay-overs, statements and return files, settlement offers within limits with approvals, a creditor portal, and debit-order providers in the Marketplace. New reports show contact funnel, promise quality, liquidation by handover month, expected money and bucket movement from month-end snapshots, and agents see their own figures on the desk's Collections tab.

Arrears: a new Arrears hub with subjects, parties, charges and settings. Agents get an Arrears tab on the desk, with arrears reports, dashboard and wallboard tiles, arrears fields in smart lists and the starter set, journeys that can name one kind of account, and guides and Academy courses.

Insurance module: Sales to issue, Premium written and Cooling-off cancellations reports, a renewal date on policies, and a starter set.

Sales: follow-ups on a journey (stuck deals, stage days and an hourly sweep), quotes with price lists and discount approvals, a signature pad, several pipelines with lost reasons, and a module mode.

BPO module: the time split per client, staffing per contract and cost per agent hour, with a nightly job.

Admin assistant: ask in plain words, by voice, or with an Excel or CSV file. It creates users, agents, teams and queues; drafts and ed"}
